text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон now looks completely at
home
standing center stage in a winning
concert.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's gaining fame as an up-and-coming
dirt
racer, and bloggers have taken note
of her
concert performances.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the term "Umadol" starting to
become
recognized, Смарт Фалкон drives
forward toward
her dream of becoming a
top Umadol.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, given her ambitions on dirt, no
one
expects her to compete in the turf
Classic Triple
Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон overhears fans saying it's a
shame
they can't see Falco's high-energy
performances
on a stage as grand as the
Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
